name: Big A
summary: Five-player Chinese climbing game where two holders of matching Aces secretly partner against three opponents to shed cards first.
rules_text: Played with two 54-card packs (108 cards) with red and black Jokers. Five players draw one by one anti-clockwise, holding last draw face down. During drawing any player may expose an Ace to make its rank/suit the Big Ace; the holder of the duplicate Ace becomes secret partner. Overcall with a pair of identical Aces steals declaration and forces solo play. If none exposed, first heart Ace holder in turn must expose. Partner may expose at end to raise stakes. Deal gives 22 cards to first three drawers, 21 to others. Leader (partner if revealed else declarer) leads any single, pair, sequence of 3+, double sequence of 3+ pairs, or bomb. Bombs are triplets+, pairs of Jokers, triplet sequences, consecutive quads, 7- and 8-of-a-kind, three/four Jokers, and Big Ace pair, ranking 3 high to 4 low within type, higher type beating lower. Players in turn must beat previous combo or pass; play continues until all cards shed. Score by finishing order and solo/partner exposure.
